openpii.note: train split only; eval sample uids and texts excluded (openpii.py)

privy.attribution: Privy (Pixie / New Relic), published as piimb/privy

label_map.label: O
label_map.note: Privy marks some generated values (e-mails, URLs) 'O': unknown, so ignored

label_map.label: LOCATION
label_map.note: an address, a city or a country: too mixed to teach, ignored

label_map.label: first_name
label_map.note: merged with an adjacent last_name into one PERSON span

label_map.label: company_name
label_map.note: ORGANIZATION is a keep type: scored for recall, never a leak

label_map.label: city
label_map.note: ADDRESS inside an address; on its own policy-excluded

label_map.label: credit_debit_card
label_map.note: cards are BANK_ACCOUNT in pii-guard's taxonomy

label_map.label: date
label_map.note: any date, not only birth dates: policy-excluded

label_map.label: medical_record_number
label_map.note: health and demographic labels have no pii-guard type

label_map.label: STREET_NAME
label_map.note: a street name on its own is not an address (v2.1 negatives)

negatives.note: the v2 negatives only; not the v2.1 uncued-ID ones (they caused ID/e-mail leaks)

s11.note: the LAB-1128 files as generated; s13 is not kept and was not regenerated

excluded.fineweb-2: real web text: ADR 0005 allows no real personal data in training (LAB-1393 follow-up asks the owner)
excluded.distill-s13: not kept after v2 and not reproducible from a seed (LLM output)
excluded.negatives-v21: the uncued-ID negatives caused the v2.1 ID and e-mail leaks
excluded.cc-by-sa / nc / gated: none used (no NerKor, no Universal NER)
